sloka: ततः स सान्त्वयामास सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।स्त्रीहेतोर्वालिना भ्रात्रा निरस्तमुरुतेजसा ।। ५.३५.३४।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa sāntvayāmāsa sugrīvaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।strīhetorvālinā bhrātrā nirastamurutejasā ।। 5.35.34।।।।

translations.english: "Then Rama, consoled Sugriva who was dethroned and abandoned on acount of a woman by his brother Vali, endowed with great prowess.
